fusions.name: Bitter Meal
fusions.desc: Sends locusts into the first enemy they meet for 9 poison damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions; the locusts eat one of them.

fusions.name: Decanted Plague
fusions.desc: Pours a cone of locusts 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 poison damage to everything in it and leaving them [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Venom Gleaners
fusions.desc: The swarm eats up to 3 poison conditions off you, and you regain 12 health.

fusions.name: Seasoned Carriers
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
